## Appendix A: The Complete 2026–2030 Pool (sample)

Every question below is quoted verbatim from the 2026–2030 Technician pool, with the correct answer marked and a one-line why pointing at the chapter that teaches it.

> **T1A01** Which agency regulates the amateur service in the United States?
> A. The FCC
> B. The ITU
> C. The Department of Defense
> D. The United Nations
> **Answer: A** — the FCC is the US regulator (chapter 8).

> **T1A02** What is the purpose of the amateur service?
> A. Advancing skills in the technical and communication phases of the radio art
> B. Broadcasting music to the general public
> C. Providing commercial message traffic
> D. Coordinating military communications
> **Answer: A** — this is the service's stated purpose (chapter 0).
